description: Live AIS position, speed, heading and voyage status (destination, ETA, draught) for one vessel by 9-digit MMSI, from Finland's Digitraffic AIS feed. Covers Finnish and Baltic waters only, not global coverage; vessels outside that area return no position. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: logistics_vessel_tracker
title: Live AIS position, speed, heading and voyage status for one
